book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Refera Vazeḡa Fainiro
Iesuꞌa maḡanonoꞌo ovairotene, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa ane hegote onamiro.
Ebu refera vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa ani vaḡe aradu ane zamao obenaḡa hina tuḡadu niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡa uratine, eḡe faihogaꞌe idaraꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌa einadu vaze eꞌe oboniro ebu niro, “E urateꞌohe. Ḡaꞌe deheru manoroꞌi!” ꞌOugadu refera eꞌeꞌa zogone manoriro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Vazeni ꞌahoga ago noꞌi. Rehano dibuꞌo vazeḡa vaḡe onamadu ahiriḡo ihonoꞌi. Ebu ḡaeꞌa manorateꞌe vazeꞌa ederifine, Moseꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡahunoneḡa mae onamadu Badiꞌa dibuꞌohanoꞌi.”
Uti Vazeḡa Boroꞌa Iesu mazao Firo
Iesuꞌa Kaperanauma diuḡirotene, uti vazeḡa boro ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu dananoga uminiro,
ebu ꞌahige rae niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eḡe tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahogaꞌe ahiꞌa haganoga mene idaḡa radu neo bazeꞌohe zu ufeta giginadu ḡaniḡanauꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Eḡeꞌa onamadu fainiꞌuma.”
Rehano uti vazeḡa boroꞌa naenaeniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eꞌe mene vaze manoḡa, eꞌanoꞌo ḡaeꞌa eḡe ne diuḡogaꞌe mene idaḡa. Rehano ḡae ḡoere daꞌo roꞌi, ꞌougine eḡe tuḡure vazeḡaniꞌa manoriꞌuma.

Mazaḡa eḡe zuni vaze ꞌahoga ꞌuꞌuḡano gaueꞌohe, ebu uti azaḡa zuni eḡe ꞌuꞌuḡano gaueꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa uti vazeḡa ꞌahi ninaꞌa, 'Onamoꞌi,' raꞌetene aniꞌe onameꞌohe, ebu ꞌahoga ꞌomo ninaꞌa, 'Aroꞌi,' raꞌetene aniꞌe areꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa eḡe tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahoga ninaꞌa, 'ꞌAdi haḡaoꞌi,' raꞌetene aniꞌe haḡaeꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa eꞌe ḡoeꞌa igirotene zaguzagaro ebu ane hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, Isaraela azaḡa boꞌaḡano ꞌahige fie gigaruꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe e ꞌize mene horoneha.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa madaꞌa iteꞌeteꞌe moneonoꞌo zu madaꞌa zubureꞌeteꞌe moneonoꞌo aradu adureo Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe habaꞌano Aberahamo, Isako zu Iakobo teite ogau tiburaꞌuma.
Rehano Iuda azaḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ze zuhiꞌaziꞌohe rae zamareꞌe rehano, enona mae feuzadu uzabo zamaḡano radiꞌuma, ebu eꞌea niaꞌuma zu ḡononeze atitiꞌuma.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa uti vazeḡa boro niro, “Onamoꞌi. Ḡaꞌe eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe uꞌano, ḡae tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe manoriꞌuma.” Aniꞌa ꞌouge reiroteꞌe madaḡano tuḡure vazeḡa aꞌe manoriro.
Vaze Ḡehaḡa Faiziro
Ebu Iesuꞌa Petero ne diuḡirotene, Petero emoḡa roḡaeḡa ahiꞌaniꞌa gigine runadu evane rana baze radoga horoniro.
Iesuꞌa roḡae eꞌe ꞌevoꞌa obonirotene, ahiꞌa gigiꞌa ꞌai dauḡiro. Ebu ani iḡunadu Iesu veize ogomu ruhibiro.
Ḡoravararotene, vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa vine sauꞌaniꞌa ragano reiroteꞌe azaḡa ḡehaḡa Iesu vaḡe tutuze ariro. Aniꞌe ḡoere hina vine sauꞌa hegoze buziro ebu ugi azaḡa niduꞌa faiziro.
ꞌOugadu Badiꞌaꞌa peroveta vazeḡa Isaiaonoꞌo reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudaro, “Aniꞌe emeḡe gigiꞌa meiro ebu emeḡe ugi odohiro.”
Iesu Hegoteꞌeteꞌe Vazeḡa
Iesuꞌa ane uhiḡano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa horozirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Duꞌura moneafa fare onamihi.”
Eꞌe madaḡano Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, ḡaꞌa noꞌe onamine eḡeꞌa ḡae hegotiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Butu ḡuniḡaꞌe bazuni habaꞌazeta ebu hitana niniḡaꞌe nezeta. Rehano Vaze Ubugaꞌe bazuni habaꞌa oꞌoꞌa.”
Ebu Iesu tahiꞌa ꞌahoganiꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, e ibite geno mamahe guri onamihi.”
Rehano Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌe eḡe hegotoꞌi. Rune azaḡaniꞌa rune azaḡa guriꞌuma.”
Zavara ꞌUiro
Ebu Iesuꞌa ḡasio tirirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ani hegote tiriro.
Ebu zavara boroꞌa duꞌurao feuriro ebu saꞌuꞌa ḡasio kafere diuḡiro. Rehano Iesuꞌe baze radiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo ze ane vaḡe onamadu evaniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eme ḡabofoꞌi! Eme hunuhuneꞌohe!”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Za nougadu rihauꞌohe? Zaꞌa eḡe mazao fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe komeꞌa!” Ebu ani iḡunadu zavara zu saꞌu roziro. ꞌOugirotene, zavara zu saꞌuꞌe roḡeru hauḡiro.
Ebu zeꞌa zaguzagauꞌenaꞌa, ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌahiꞌe nagi vaze? Zavara zu saꞌuꞌa zuni ani ḡoere egohuꞌohe!”
Vine Sauꞌazeta Azaḡa Faiziro
Iesuꞌa duꞌura moneafa, Gadara
azaḡa habao feurirotene, vine sauꞌazeta azaḡa aheuꞌa idu habaꞌanonoꞌo areꞌenogano Iesu hidiro. Zamazeꞌe ufeta ḡugiziro ꞌahine, eꞌe ibiḡano vazeꞌa onamoga mene idararo.
Ebu ze Iesu ḡihau ḡoreniro, “Badiꞌa Ubuga, ḡaꞌe emeḡe mazao nagini urateꞌohe? Ḡaꞌe, kota madaḡa ḡonaga ꞌizema mougano, aduga rifoga veize emeḡe vaḡe arahe?”
Zeḡe mazaonoꞌo faḡano aba ḡehaḡaniꞌa ogau radiunu.
Ebu vine sauꞌasauꞌaniꞌa Iesu uminiro, “Ḡaeꞌa eme hegofe bufoꞌidene, aba ḡuḡuvaḡa ꞌomo mazao tuḡufoꞌi.”

Ebu aniꞌa vine sauꞌasauꞌa ziro, “Onamoꞌi!” ꞌOuge reirotene, ze vaze aheu mazaonoꞌo buanadu aba ḡuḡuvaḡa zamaḡano diuḡiro. Ebu aba ḡuḡuvaḡa niduꞌaꞌe maḡa komeꞌa gagaḡanonoꞌo dure ovoradu duꞌurao hunuhune rudaro.
ꞌOugirotene, aba taufeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa neze ferau manahadu vine sauꞌasauꞌaniꞌa ragano reiroteꞌe azaḡa mazao naginiꞌa fureraroteꞌe hariḡa niduꞌa meꞌodoziniro.
Ebu ne azaḡa niduꞌa buanadu Iesu hidoga veize ariro. Ze Iesu horonirotene, aniꞌe zeḡe habaꞌanonoꞌo vaḡinoga uminiro.
